simple.summary: עַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה (ʻAlmôn Diblâthâyᵉmâh) means Almon-Diblathajemah , a place in Moab First listed occurrence: Num 33 46.

definitions.full: H5963. Almon Diblathayemah דִּבְלָתָ֑יְמָה עַלְמוֺן proper name, of a location in Moab , Num 33:46-47 , (P), ᵐ5 Γελμων Δεβλαθαιμ ; = ד ׳בֵּית q. v.
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 5960 and the dual of 1960 (compare 1015 ) with enclitic of direction; Almon towards Diblathajim;
